source: gh api 'repos/swasik/itsm-2026-submissions/issues?state=all&per_page=100' --paginate --jq '.[] | select(any(.labels[]; .name == "receipted") and any(.labels[]; .name == "kind:submission")) | {number, attempt: (try (.title | capture("lab[0-9]+/v(?<attempt>[0-9]+)").attempt | tonumber) catch null)}'
method: Each receipted class submission is one delivery observation; a corrected tag version v2 or later is counted as rework.
limitation: The shared receipt history does not expose the R-15 unplanned and caused_by fields, so corrected submissions are an explicit proxy for deployment rework.
